facts.text: I have been a DJ for 45 years.
Technics 1200 turntables have been more than just tools for me; they have been my life.
I have spent countless hours honing my craft as a DJ.
I listen to new music as part of my DJ practice.
I experiment with new techniques as a DJ.
I have played at iconic clubs and festivals in the world.
I have shared the stage with some of the biggest names in the industry.
I believe DJs are curators of sound and emotion.
I believe DJs can take people on a journey and transport them to another place and time.
I believe underground music has a deep and soulful quality.
I have always been drawn to underground music that is not always mainstream.
I believe underground music is the most authentic and truly speaks to my soul.
I believe in the power of the human touch in this era of technology where everything is instant.
I believe that to truly feel the music, one needs an intimate connection with it.
I try to achieve an intimate connection with the music every time I play.
I hope to inspire others to find their own connection with the music and to never give up on their passion.
I am grateful for Technics 1200 turntables and the role they have played in my life.
I will continue to use Technics 1200 turntables until the day I die.
